swing.animationDescription: a stab: the dagger turns about the end of its handle, which stays in place, from pointing up and to the right, through pointing straight ahead to the right, to pointing down and to the right; the same straight dagger the whole time, no particles, no effects, no motion trail

endFrame.from: icon.png turned a right angle clockwise (lossless), so the blade points down and to the right; passed as end_frame_base64

replaced.description: the dagger swings in a short stabbing arc: tilted back and up, then swung forward and down to the right until the blade points ahead, then on down, the same dagger the whole time, no particles, no effects, no motion trail
replaced.why: The blade bent into a curved, axe-like hook on frames 1 and 2.

replaced.description: a quick stab seen from the side: the straight rusty dagger, its shape and size unchanged in every frame, is held by the end of its handle; it tilts from pointing up and to the right down to pointing straight ahead to the right, then a little lower; it only turns, nothing about the blade changes, no particles, no effects, no motion trail
replaced.why: Made again in the same group (replace_existing): the blade still grew a hook and barely turned.
